Walmart: no coupon gallery — Walmart Cash manufacturer offers in the app, and offers vary by account. No genuinely notable Walmart Cash offer found this week — nothing shortlisted. Walmart Cash posts after purchase and is spent on a future purchase.
CVS / Walgreens: ExtraBucks and Register Rewards are later rewards for a future purchase, not checkout discounts — final prices value them at face value, per the bloggers' math.

Target: Circle bonus offers are account-specific — your account may differ; activate before shopping. Thanksgiving Meal for 6 — $30 total, Nov 8-29, no coupon needed. Target Black Friday ad starts Sun Nov 22.
DG penny list: new list effective Fri Nov 20 (see note above); last week's clearance prices expired with the Nov 19 event end — do not carry forward.
